subject: A process change should address an actionable, corroborated, traceable difficulty within the permitted scope; if evidence identifies no such actionable process, no speculative change should be made.
rationale: The rule prospectively gates the week-one decision: any selected change must address a corroborated, traceable difficulty within scope; absent such an actionable process, make no speculative change. These requirements and the explicit no-change response form a coherent decision structure. Although the qualitative criteria require judgment, they sufficiently specify this eligibility rule without requiring a unique intervention choice. This assessment does not establish that any qualifying difficulty has been observed.
